text: With the Warranty Claim object built, Devon Okafor's next job is deciding who can see a claim before a single record exists.
He sets the organization-wide default to Private -- nobody sees a claim unless they own it, or the org chart says otherwise.
Private comes with Grant Access Using Hierarchies checked by default: any role above an owner's role inherits that owner's access automatically.
Devon documents that behavior as a named policy, Warranty_Claim_Manager_Visibility, so it's a deliberate decision, not an invisible default.
Next: building the actual Role Hierarchy and the permission sets that make day-to-day access work for reps and managers.
